sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: The US Food and Drug Administration ordered manufacturers of GLP-1 weight-loss and diabetes drugs, including Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Zepbound and Soliqua, to add warning labels about nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy. NAION is a rare condition caused by reduced blood flow to the optic nerve, which can lead to sudden and permanent vision loss in one eye.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: An FDA review of clinical trials and studies indicated an increased risk of NAION among GLP-1 users. However, Novo Nordisk and the American Academy of Ophthalmology noted that a direct cause-and-effect link has not been established. Patients taking these drugs often already have separate NAION risk factors, such as diabetes and high blood pressure.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: The American Academy of Ophthalmology advises patients not to stop taking GLP-1 medications without speaking to their doctor, and to consult an ophthalmologist immediately if sudden vision loss occurs.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: In April 2023, photographer Rhiannon Adam witnessed the SpaceX Starship vehicle break apart during a test flight in Texas. Adam had been selected for the dearMoon project, a private mission funded by Yusaku Maezawa. By mid-2024, the project was cancelled, leaving participants surprised.

sections.text: The cancellation of the project significantly impacted Adam, who had integrated the mission into her personal and professional identity. Her subsequent work, Rhi-Entry, critiques the traditional image of space travellers and examines the ethics of space colonisation.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: The US midterm elections resulted in a defeat for Donald Trump’s Republicans and a Democratic-controlled Congress. While this outcome brought relief to some European capitals, experts warn that the US president may now use his foreign policy powers to act more aggressively on the world stage. European leaders remain concerned about potential trade tariffs and the impact on Ukraine.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The results have sparked debate over whether the US outcome signals a turning point for European politics. While some view it as a sign of democratic resilience, others note that populist parties in Europe remain strong. European mainstream parties face pressure to address issues like housing and inflation to avoid losing further ground to anti-system movements.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Europe faces critical upcoming tests, including a general election in Spain where a coalition between the Popular Party and the far-right Vox is possible. Meanwhile, European progressive parties are being urged to channel youth-led protest energy into meaningful political change to counter the appeal of nationalist populism.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Developers from Rockstar North spent over a decade researching Miami to create the fictional Vice City for Grand Theft Auto VI. The team conducted field trips, including ridealongs with police and visits to local bars, to capture the atmosphere and physical details of the region. This research informs the game's environment, from architecture to minor interactive elements.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The game's high level of detail is attributed to significant time and financial investment from parent company Take-Two Interactive. By grounding the virtual world in real-world experiences, the developers aim to create a believable, immersive environment for players.
